lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.read_dog_share(share_slug text)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/read_dog_share`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.read_movie_share(share_slug text)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/read_movie_share`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

lints.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.read_dog_share(share_slug text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/read_dog_share`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.read_movie_share(share_slug text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/read_movie_share`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

lints.name: auth_leaked_password_protection
lints.title: Leaked Password Protection Disabled
lints.description: Leaked password protection is currently disabled.

findings.detail: Supabase Auth prevents the use of compromised passwords by checking against HaveIBeenPwned.org. Enable this feature to enhance security.

disposition: The two public exact-slug RPCs intentionally use SECURITY DEFINER with fixed SQL, empty search_path, active-only filters and public-field projection. anon/authenticated execution is required for approved unlisted-link viewing. Password protection advisory unchanged/out of scope; no Auth settings changed.
